summaryZh: 静态SVG与循环动画对明确约束执行较稳，参数化书架尺寸正确但材质简单。四支知识视频经修正后形成完整的带字幕讲解，仍有示意与措辞精度的局限。复杂Blender任务暴露了明显问题：减速器实际载盘与轴未联动、啮合画面遮挡；室内场景的动线、材质与镜头可读性不足。作品交付和质量通过分别记录，不以作者自检代替实际检查。
summaryEn: Static SVGs and the loop animation follow explicit constraints consistently; the parametric bookshelf has correct dimensions but simple materials. The four corrected knowledge videos deliver complete captioned explanations, with remaining schematic and wording limits. Complex Blender tasks show clear failures: the reducer's physical carriers and shafts do not follow the motion and meshing is obscured; the interior has circulation, material and camera-readability problems. Delivery and quality acceptance are recorded separately; author selfchecks do not replace inspection.
methodZh: 作品、工程源码与口播脚本由指定的 Crouton Alpha 模型在 OpenCode v2.2.5 每案例持久会话中以路由 openrouter/stealth/crouton-alpha 创作。Codex 协调者检查像素与技术 QA，并有时在持久控制器任务中执行作者提供的确切前台渲染命令；协调者未做艺术修正，未使用其他创作模型。QA = 作者自检 + 协调者 AI 检查与独立进程测量，不是盲评、独立人类分数，也不是全部在同一个 Crouton 会话内完成。环境为 harness 默认；仅指定的只读检查/捕获工具禁用网络，不声称全程离线。长 wall 时间含产出、模型、渲染、排队、闲置、恢复与协调者 QA，非模型速度。冻结范围 3 Blender + 4 知识视频 + 3 静态 SVG + 1 SVG 动画，日期 2026-11-04，主题 SHA 见冻结 batch；共享 Pillow/NumPy/FFmpeg/浏览器 SVG 能力与公共 Kokoro TTS 制作工具（口播脚本由模型编写，声音非模型原生；知识-4 变速已披露）。native completedResponses 为 assistant step_finish 计数，非实际提供方请求；时钟沿用既有 Build 12 步，成功的 preflight Plan 与外部出版工作排除在外，本地 trial receipt 保留。
methodEn: Artworks, project sources and narration scripts were authored by the exact Crouton in native OpenCode v2.2.5 persistent per-case sessions via route openrouter/stealth/crouton-alpha. Codex coordinators inspected pixels and technical QA and sometimes executed the exact author-supplied foreground render commands in persistent controller jobs; coordinators made no artistic fixes and no other creative models were used. QA = author self-checks plus coordinator AI inspection and separate-process measurements, NOT blind or independent human scores, and NOT all inside one Crouton session. The environment is the harness default; only specified read-only inspection/capture tools deny networking, with no whole-offline claim. Long wall time includes productive, model, render, queue, idle/resume and coordinator-QA time, not model speed. Frozen scope 3 Blender + 4 knowledge videos + 3 static SVG + 1 SVG animation, date 2026-11-04, topic SHA from frozen batch; shared Pillow/NumPy/FFmpeg/browser SVG capabilities and the common Kokoro TTS production tool (scripts model-authored, voice NOT model-native; knowledge-4 speedup disclosed). Native completedResponses are assistant step_finish counts, NOT actual provider requests; the clock reuses the existing Build 12 steps, the successful preflight Plan and external publication work are excluded, and the local trial receipt is retained.
billingZh: OpenRouter 官方列出输入/输出价格为零；实际发票未核实，不从归一化计数推断费用。
billingEn: OpenRouter officially lists zero input/output prices; the actual invoice is unverified, and no cost is inferred from normalized counters.
usageNoteZh: 计数为原生 assistant step_finish（非提供方请求）；输出为可见输出加单独报告的 reasoning 各计一次；缺失的上游计数被归一化为 0，不是原始账单；时钟为 Build 12 步范围，preflight Plan、出版与协调者用量排除，本地 trial receipt 保留。 聚合已知小计（OpenCode 归一化 harness 计数，非原始发票）：输入 28,919,558、输出 241,645（可见输出 238,506 + 单独报告的推理 3,139）；完整总量未知，实际提供方请求数未知，发票未知。部分用例的 wallMs 含长时间闲置/恢复/排队与协调者 QA，非模型推理速度。
usageNoteEn: Counts are native assistant step_finish events (NOT provider requests); outputs are visible output plus separately reported reasoning counted once; missing upstream counters are normalized to 0, not raw billing; the clock uses the Build 12-step scope with preflight Plan, publication and coordinator usage excluded and the local trial receipt preserved. Aggregate KNOWN subtotals (OpenCode normalized harness counters, not raw invoices): input 28,919,558, output 241,645 (visible output 238,506 + separately reported reasoning 3,139); complete totals UNKNOWN, actual provider request count UNKNOWN, invoice UNKNOWN. Some cases' wallMs includes long idle/resume/queue time and coordinator QA, never model inference speed.
limitationsZh: 匿名厂商与固定 checkpoint 未公开，未复现官方 benchmark 图/分数。
共享固定 Kokoro zf_xiaobei 为制作工具，非模型原生语音；降噪 1.15× 与分段级字幕已披露；无听审或人类分数。
已知归一化 assistant-step 计数不是原始提供方请求或发票；一条被中断的减速器消息用量为 null，故完整 token 总量未知。时钟 Build 12 步范围排除原 preflight Plan；出版/协调者用量排除。
冻结同日主题/规格哈希保留；原始流水线适配与共享主机资源争用已披露；wall 时间非推理速度。
机械联动、衣帽间动线、成片遮挡、灰模对比与科学措辞的 partial/fail 结论保留；无制造/载荷或全 UV/LOD 认证。
limitationsEn: Anonymous vendor and fixed checkpoint undisclosed; no official benchmark image/score reproduced.
Shared fixed Kokoro zf_xiaobei is a production tool, not native model speech; ANC 1.15x and segment-level captions disclosed; no listening or human score.

Known normalized assistant-step counters are not raw provider requests or invoices; one interrupted reducer message has null usage, so full token totals unknown. Clock Build 12-step scope excludes original preflight Plan; publication/coordinator usage excluded.
Frozen same-day topics/spec hashes retained; original pipeline adaptations and shared host resource contention disclosed; wall time not inference speed.
Mechanical linkage, wardrobe route, film occlusion, gray contrast and scientific wording partial/fail findings retained; no manufacturing/load or universal UV/LOD certification.

cases.prompt: 24/18/60-tooth planetary reducer: assembly, four stills and a 6s turntable film.
assessmentZh: 同一Crouton会话保留并修正首版错误：内齿圈误用外齿公式，验证器以世界原点筛选行星轮导致轮廓空缺。最终局部轮廓有非空保护，齿数24/18/60、中心距42mm和传动比3.5；9个重开相位及20个二维离散相位未见轮廓交叉。这不是连续接触、载荷或制造验证。
协调者另用禁网、禁自动执行的独立重开进程测7个时点的世界变换：太阳轮转540度，公转轴154.286度，行星轮世界转角-360度，内齿圈固定；但两个实际载盘和输入/输出轴世界转角均为0。作者的公转轴比值检查不足以证明完整机械联动。
0.08度半齿厚角侧隙是名义展示选择，未证明为全局最小；公差配合、接触应力和制造可用性未测试。
已查看全部四张真实静帧和动画三个contact sheet。备选及灰模图可辨接触区域，主图和动画的不透明前盘遮挡多数内部结构，材质与照明整体灰淡。动画仅部分可见运动，不能据此判为啮合展示通过。
原始工程禁用自动执行重开，哈希未变且无嵌入文本或外部图像。UV层和LOD网格存在，但未做完整UV重叠/密度或全LOD视觉验收。
成片1280×720、24fps、144帧、6秒，完整解码及客观音轨检查通过；未听审。一次协调者中断的模型消息没有token记录，公开用量只能是已知小计，完整总量未知。
assessmentEn: The same Crouton session preserved and repaired first-version errors: external tooth law reused for the ring, and a world-origin filter leaving planet profiles empty. Final local profiles have nonempty guards; teeth24/18/60,42mm centers and ratio3.5. Nine reopened phases and20 discrete2D phases show no outline crossings, without continuous-contact, load or manufacturing validation.

A separate coordinator process reopened the unchanged blend with network and autoexec disabled and sampled world transforms at7times: sun540degrees, orbit pivot154.286degrees, planet world rotation-360degrees and ring fixed. Both physical carrier discs and input/output shafts remain at zero rotation; the author pivot-ratio test does not establish complete mechanical linkage.
The0.08degree half-angle backlash is a nominal display choice, not a globally minimum proof. Tolerances, stresses and manufacturability are untested.

The coordinator viewed all four actual stills and all three film contact sheets. Alt/clay expose a contact region, but the opaque front disc hides most internals in the main view and film; materials and lighting remain pale. Visible partial motion does not pass clear meshing presentation.

The blend reopens with autoexec disabled, unchanged hash and no embedded text/external images. UV layers and LOD meshes exist; complete UV overlap/density and all-LOD visual acceptance were not performed.

1280x720,24fps,144frames,6s, full decode and objective audio checks pass; no listening. One coordinator-interrupted model message has no token record, so usage is a known subtotal, not a complete total.

assessmentZh: 84.5秒视频流，容器含音频尾部为84.6秒；1920×1080、30fps，完整音视频解码通过。
实际查看三张成片contact sheet的十个时点，包括片头、片尾、字幕及主要机制。材料与五层取舍对应NASA来源；图形为定性示意，没有热学仿真。
厚板对比图朝向交代不足；部分层间小字对比度较弱，不能把作者自检改写为所有视觉表达均通过。
口播使用统一Kokoro制作工具，非模型原生语音。未听审，发音、听感和完整语义同步未由真人认证。
assessmentEn: 84.5s video stream; container 84.6s including audio tail; 1920×1080 at 30fps and full A/V decode pass.

The coordinator viewed all three encoded contact sheets covering ten moments, head/tail, captions and core mechanisms. Materials and layer tradeoffs follow NASA; diagrams are qualitative, without thermal simulation.
The thick-plate orientation change is insufficiently explained and some small inter-layer labels have weak contrast; author selfchecks do not establish universal visual correctness.
Narration uses the shared Kokoro production tool, not native model speech. No listening review; pronunciation, sound quality and complete semantic sync are not human-certified.

checks.detailZh: 84.6秒容器、1080p30，完整解码通过；抽取尾帧按视频流时长，避免AAC尾部超出最后画面。
checks.detailEn: 84.6s container, 1080p30, full decode passes; tail samples use video-stream duration rather than the AAC tail.

checks.detailZh: 五层分隔、侧向散热、Kapton/铝/最热两层向阳面硅涂层及二至七层建模取舍与NASA页面一致。
checks.detailEn: Separated films, lateral heat radiation, Kapton/aluminium/sun-facing silicon on the hottest two layers and 2-7-layer modelling agree with NASA.

checks.detailZh: 厚板图底向上热流与其他镜头热侧在上的约定缺少明确转换；部分层间小字对比偏弱。
checks.detailEn: Bottom-to-top flow in the plate panel lacks a declared orientation change from the other shots' hot-side-above convention; some small labels have weak contrast.

checks.detailZh: 13条SRT均在成片范围内且不重叠，抽帧可见烧入中文字幕。
checks.detailEn: All 13 SRT cues lie within the film without overlap; burned Chinese captions are visible in samples.

checks.detailZh: 仅做客观音频检查；未听审。
checks.detailEn: Objective audio checks only; listening not performed.

cases.titleEn: Why does noise cancellation work without music?
cases.summaryZh: 成片用被动隔音与麦克风—处理器—扬声器路径、三路波形解释降噪，保留人声与密封条件；图示是耳边局部的幅度失配示意，不是耳机性能实测。
cases.summaryEn: Passive isolation, the microphone-processor-speaker path and three waveform traces explain noise cancellation, retaining voice and seal limits; the illustration is a local-at-ear amplitude-mismatch schematic, not device performance measurement.

media.captionEn: Why noise cancellation works without music

assessmentZh: 被动隔音与主动信号路径分开说明；实际信号加法正确，残余显示的是耳边局部幅度失配，不是耳机设备性能。
全部五处交叉淡化与字幕时间技术检查通过。
约70.7秒“即使是理想示意里的相消，也仍有残余声”措辞不精确：可见模拟是幅度失配，不能断言完全等幅反相仍有残余。
14段字幕对应真实Kokoro合成分段（非逐词），口播为已披露的1.15倍变速；未听审，发音与可听性未认证。
assessmentEn: Passive isolation and the active signal path are separately explained; the actual signal sums are correct, and the residual shown is local-at-ear amplitude mismatch, not headphone device performance.
All five crossfades and caption-timing/fade technical checks pass.

The line near 70.7s, 'even in the idealized cancellation there is residual sound', is imprecise: the visible simulation is amplitude mismatch; do not claim perfectly equal-amplitude opposite waves retain residual.

Fourteen captions follow real Kokoro synthesis chunks (not word-level); narration is disclosed 1.15x speedup from Kokoro zf_xiaobei, not native model voice. No listening review; pronunciation not certified.

checks.detailEn: 79.59s, 1920×1080, 30fps, full decode passes.

checks.detailZh: 被动隔音与主动路径分开；三路波形实际加法正确，耳边局部幅度失配示意。
checks.detailEn: Passive and active paths separated; three-waveform sums correct as local-at-ear amplitude-mismatch illustration.

checks.detailZh: 五处交叉淡化与14段字幕时间技术检查通过；字幕为合成分段，非逐词。
checks.detailEn: Five crossfades and 14-caption timing checks pass; captions follow synthesis chunks, not word-level.

checks.detailZh: “理想示意相消仍有残余”措辞过松；可见模拟是幅度失配，不证明等幅反相有残余。
checks.detailEn: 'Idealized cancellation retains residual' is too loose; visible simulation is amplitude mismatch, not proof equal-amplitude opposite waves retain residual.

checks.detailZh: 未听审；Kokoro zf_xiaobei 1.15倍变速，非模型原生语音，发音未认证。
